mapper.select: SELECT bbp.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS processNumber, bbp.PROCESSINESS_KEY AS processKey, bbp.user_name AS userName, bbp.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, bbp.process_state AS processState, bbp.PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInstId FROM bpm_business_process bbp WHERE bbp.process_state = 1 AND bbp.is_del = 0 AND bbp.CREATE_TIME >= #{timeLowerBound} ORDER BY bbp.CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT #{batchSize} OFFSET #{offset}
